newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI says no comment on Palmer request.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI says no comment on Palmer request.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Friday it had no comment on a request by former director Ross Palmer for an extraordinary meeting of shareholders.
An ANI spokesman said the company would respond once it had considered the Palmer request, made earlier in the day.
Palmer said he had sought an extraordinary meeting to consider the removal of directors Peter Joseph and Howard Stack.

Joseph was instrumental in Palmer's removal at ANI's annual meeting last month, which followed a dispute between the two over the company's handling of its troubled German environmental engineering division.
